title: CallCompleted v1
description: One finished call-centre call: its metadata and its full transcript. Published by the call centre (in this system: the simulator and the eval) as the body of ONE message on the call queue; consumed by chatbot-backend's call worker. Delivery is at-least-once, so a consumer must treat call_id as the idempotency key. contracts/README.md § 'Call-centre calls' holds the rules no schema can state.

schema_version.description: The major version of this schema. A breaking change is a new file and a new value, never an edit to this one.

event_id.description: Unique per publish. Two events for the same call (a correction, a redelivery) share call_id and differ here.

call_id.description: The call centre's own identifier, as a person quotes it — e.g. CALL-20261021000123. The idempotency key: the latest event for a call_id replaces every earlier one.

started_at.description: RFC 3339 with an offset. When the customer was connected.

ended_at.description: RFC 3339 with an offset, not before started_at. Retention is measured from this instant.

queue.description: The call-centre queue that handled the call. Known values: billing, technical_support, sales, cancellations, general. A consumer must tolerate an unknown one.

phone_masked.description: Already masked by the producer. A consumer must never receive, and must refuse to store, an unmasked number.

outcome.description: Known values: resolved, escalated, callback_scheduled, transferred, abandoned. A consumer must tolerate an unknown one.

csat.description: Post-call satisfaction score, or null when the customer gave none.

transcript.description: The whole call, in spoken order.
